issues.reason: Agent-nominalization says where the capability fires is fixed — a symbol fused from the surface or a copular predicate — and lists the appositive among the merely referring uses where you 'type the referent and stop', so (Inheritance producer (can produce)) is unlicensed.

'One of the world's largest producers' has no licensed encoding (Most is the unique superlative, Partitives needs a quantified subject), and (Degree weyerhaeuser large (forKind producer)) is true of the content and well-typed — the dropped 'world's' is under-specification, not a false or over-asserted atom, so this is improvisation in the gap the reviewer itself records.

The measure phrase IS the object here, so no Patient entity is stated and inventing one would break 'assert only what the text states'; 'quantity' as a scale term and the lemmatized compound rate unit follow the attested (Degree N quantity ...) and kilometer_per_hour conventions, and the atom (about 7.6e9 board feet a year, sigma = 10%) is true and well-typed in gap territory.
